ierb_workflows:
CREATE TABLE `ierb_workflows` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `student_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `stage_key` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `revision` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `legacy_stage_snapshot` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `enrollment_evidence` text NOT NULL,
  `enrolled_by_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `enrolled_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ierb_workflow_student` (`student_id`),
  KEY `ierb_workflow_enroller_fk` (`enrolled_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_workflow_enroller_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`enrolled_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_workflow_student_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `students` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_workflow_stage` CHECK (`stage_key` in ('initial_submission','resubmission_amendment','approval_data_gathering','ierb_completed')),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_workflow_revision` CHECK (`revision` > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ierb_correction_cases:
CREATE TABLE `ierb_correction_cases` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `workflow_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `interrupted_stage` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `reason` text NOT NULL,
  `affected_documents_json` text NOT NULL,
  `requires_amendment` tinyint(4) NOT NULL,
  `opened_by_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `opened_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  `resolved_by_user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `resolved_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `resolution_evidence_json` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `active_workflow` int(11) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (case when `resolved_at` is null then `workflow_id` else NULL end) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ierb_one_open_case` (`active_workflow`),
  KEY `ierb_case_history` (`workflow_id`,`id`),
  KEY `ierb_case_opener_fk` (`opened_by_user_id`),
  KEY `ierb_case_resolver_fk` (`resolved_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_case_opener_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`opened_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_case_resolver_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`resolved_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_case_workflow_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`workflow_id`) REFERENCES `ierb_workflows` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_case_stage` CHECK (`interrupted_stage` in ('initial_submission','approval_data_gathering')),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_case_amendment` CHECK (`requires_amendment` in (0,1)),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_case_documents` CHECK (json_valid(`affected_documents_json`)),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_case_resolution` CHECK (`resolved_at` is null and `resolved_by_user_id` is null and `resolution_evidence_json` is null or `resolved_at` is not null and `resolved_by_user_id` is not null and `resolution_evidence_json` is not null and json_valid(`resolution_evidence_json`) and `resolved_at` >= `opened_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ierb_workflow_events:
CREATE TABLE `ierb_workflow_events` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `workflow_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `revision` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `event_key` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `from_stage` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `to_stage` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `correction_case_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `actor_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `reason` text NOT NULL,
  `evidence_json` text NOT NULL,
  `request_key` varchar(80) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `request_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `result_json` text NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ierb_event_request` (`workflow_id`,`request_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ierb_event_revision` (`workflow_id`,`revision`),
  KEY `ierb_event_case_fk` (`correction_case_id`),
  KEY `ierb_event_actor_fk` (`actor_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_event_actor_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_event_case_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`correction_case_id`) REFERENCES `ierb_correction_cases` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_event_workflow_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`workflow_id`) REFERENCES `ierb_workflows` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_event_evidence` CHECK (json_valid(`evidence_json`)),
  CONSTRAINT `ierb_event_result` CHECK (json_valid(`result_json`))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
